summary: On a city street in daylight, Neo dives down an alley with Agent Smith beginning to close the distance behind him. Neo speaks urgently into his cell phone, telling Tank he has serious pursuit and needs to be extracted quickly.

what_changes.before: Neo is running with some distance ahead.
what_changes.after: Agent Smith is closing in, making Neo's escape more dangerous.
what_changes.evidence: Neo dives down an alley, Agent Smith starting to gain.

event_hint.one_line: Neo is being pursued by Agent Smith and radios Tank for extraction.
